summary: Serve QSA sparse attention from an NVFP4 main K/V cache
details: QSA plans accept kv_dtype=NVFP4 (torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2): each token, KV head and side stores one 148-byte record of E2M1 values, one E4M3 scale per 16 values, and an fp32 per-row outer scale amax/(6*448), the two-level recipe of the NVFP4 MLA K/V records in b12x/attention/_shared/mla/kv_cache.py. FP8 E4M3 uses 256 bytes and BF16 512.

NVFP4 plans own a capture-safe main-cache writer: qsa.bind_kv_writer checks the caches once and returns a binding whose write() only launches; BF16 and FP8 plans keep their existing caller-side writers.
Selected-position attention widens NVFP4 records to BF16 in shared memory and is bitwise identical to BF16 attention over the decoded cache; top-k selection and the BF16 selector cache are unchanged.
